name: likeclusters
title: likeclusters
blurb: paste a handle and likeclusters reads that account's own recent posts, pulls each one's public likers, extracts a rough keyword/hashtag topic per post, and groups the likers by which topic they actually show up for — so you can see a moot who only ever likes one thing you post about. @fromthewestmeadow.com asked for a way to see which of your moots likes which topic cluster.
